depiction.primary_object: thick chisel-tip highlighter marker tilted diagonally
depiction.composition: single diagonal tool crossed out by an intersecting diagonal line

readings.meaning: remove highlighting or clear text highlight
clean permanent marker or ink stain
no markers, unannotated copy, or disable markup

ambiguity: At small sizes, the crossed-out marker can be mistaken for a generic 'no edit / read-only' pencil icon, a crossed-out eyedropper, or a lipstick tube with a slash.
task_intents: remove highlighting from document or book
